Dameon Pierce.note:
Eagles' Dameon Pierce: Back at practice Monday 
By RotoWire Staff 

Pierce (hamstring) participated in Monday's training camp practice, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports. He has been held out of practice the last two weeks after picking up a hamstring injury. He's progressed enough in his recovery to return to on-field work, putting him on track to play in Friday's preseason finale against the Bengals. Dameon Pierce, Will Shipley, and Carson Steele are battling for a depth spot in the Eagles' backfield, with Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigs.
